pharmacyInventory.workspaceSubtitle: Dispense prescriptions and manage receipt-based medication inventory.
pharmacyInventory.catalogDescription: Search formulary items and maintain reorder levels. Stock changes only through receipts and dispensing.
pharmacyInventory.catalogLoadError: Unable to load the medication catalog.
pharmacyInventory.emptyExpiry: No expired, expiring, or unknown-expiry stock lots in this period.
pharmacyInventory.expiryDescription: Receipt lots requiring expiry review, including legacy stock with unknown expiry.
pharmacyInventory.name: Medication name
pharmacyInventory.unitPriceDescription: What the invoice charges for each unit dispensed. Leave blank if not priced yet — a dispensed item without a price is reported as a billing gap instead of being charged at zero.
pharmacyInventory.unitPriceInvalid: Enter the price in rupiah, or leave it blank.
pharmacyInventory.codeDescription: Your clinic's internal code, unique per item
pharmacyInventory.kfaCodeTooltip: KFA (Kamus Farmasi dan Alat Kesehatan) is the Kemenkes product code that SATUSEHAT uses for medications, 4 to 20 digits. Search for the product by name to fill it in. Without it, this item is left out of the prescriptions and dispenses sent to SATUSEHAT.
pharmacyInventory.kfaSearchHint: Pick the product your clinic stocks. The code is filled in for you and is the one SATUSEHAT checks.
pharmacyInventory.kfaSearchError: Could not search the KFA dictionary
pharmacyInventory.kfaSearchUnavailable: The KFA lookup is unavailable right now. You can still type the code by hand.
pharmacyInventory.reorderLevelDescription: Stock level that triggers a reorder warning on the inventory tab
pharmacyInventory.isVaccineDescription: Shows this item in the immunisation picker
pharmacyInventory.isMidwifePrescribableDescription: Shows this item in a midwife's prescription picker; any other item she prescribes is refused
pharmacyInventory.batchNumberDescription: The manufacturer's lot number printed on the packaging; each lot is tracked separately for expiry
pharmacyInventory.quantityDescription: Count in the medication's stock unit (for example tablets), not packs
pharmacyInventory.receivedAtDescription: Leave empty to record the current time
pharmacyInventory.notesPlaceholder: Supplier, invoice, or delivery note number
pharmacyInventory.receiveError: Unable to record the stock receipt.
pharmacyInventory.requiredFields: Complete all required fields with valid values.
pharmacyInventory.noAbsoluteStock: Stock quantity is ledger-derived and cannot be edited directly.
pharmacyInventory.daysRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {Expires today} one {# day remaining} other {# days remaining}}
pharmacyInventory.daysExpired: Expired {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

midwifeFormulary.title: Apply the midwife formulary
midwifeFormulary.description: Items a midwife may give on her own authority under Permenkes 28/2017, matched against your catalog. Checked rows will be marked as prescribable by midwives. Nothing is unmarked.
midwifeFormulary.previewError: The midwife formulary could not be matched against the catalog.
midwifeFormulary.templateLookupSkipped: KFA could not be reached, so only exact KFA codes and name suggestions were matched. Other manufacturers of the same medicine may be missing.
midwifeFormulary.keywordHint: Matched by name only. Fill in its KFA code to mark it.
midwifeFormulary.unmatchedHint: Add this medication to the catalog, fill in its KFA code, then apply again.
midwifeFormulary.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to mark} one {Mark # medication} other {Mark # medications}}
midwifeFormulary.applied: {count, plural, =0 {No new medications marked} one {# medication marked for midwives} other {# medications marked for midwives}}
midwifeFormulary.applyError: The midwife formulary could not be applied.

pharmacyInventory.midwifeAuthorityKindDescription: Choose an authority when only a midwife holding it may write this medicine. Without it the prescription is refused and the patient goes to a doctor (PP 28/2024 Pasal 744).
